messages:
lina: Heads-up: planned ABI cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. Need final pin decision for kernel-bundle & qbuild. Release notes draft below. TL;DR: kernel v3.14.2, quant build q8-v2, eviction TTL change (staging only) 6h->2h. Requesting: pin plan, rollback criteria, docs sync.

ajay: I can take pin ops. Are we pinning globally or doing region-by-region?

lina: Region-by-region. Start EU, then US, then APAC. Staging already on kernel v3.14.2 in canary (~5% traffic).

sasha: deploy-bot: Creating rollout plan: Canary 5% for 30m -> 30% -> 70% -> 100%. Auto-rollback thresholds: p50 latency +25%, error-rate >1% for 5m, kv-evictions delta >15%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout created: kernel=3.14.2, qbuild=q8-v2, rollout_id=r-2026-03-20-01. Window 23:00-02:00 UTC.

derek: FYI we saw kv-eviction flaps in the last small canary run on older drivers. Telemetry shows TTL enforcement spiking on hosts with older GPU drivers. Recommend keeping US at 6h TTL until we confirm.

ajay: we can do region exceptions via runtime config. Example: 
```
runtime.config.set('kv.eviction.ttl', { 'region': 'us', 'ttl': '6h' })
```

lina: OK do this for US during rollout. Ajay, coordinate the config push and the rollback hook. Sasha please add a sticky pin for US until next healthy sweep.

sasha: done. `pin set region=us kernel=3.13.9 expiry=2026-04-03 reason="eviction stability"`

maria: Release notes: I'll add an entry under Known Issues: EV-342 — eviction spike under q8-v2 on older drivers and mitigation steps. Also adding migration note for private deployments.

ajay: Rollback playbook for ops: 
```
rollback r-2026-03-20-01 --to kernel=3.13.9 --drain 300s --notify oncall
```
Auto-hold condition: `holdif(latency_p50>+20% || errors>1%)`.

oncall-sre: Oncall ack. I'll watch the dashboards and PagerDuty. If auto-rollback triggers, I'll take the lead on triage and postmortem.

lina: Final Q: release notes link and docs sync PR? Maria/Ajay can you merge before 22:30 UTC?

maria: PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/458 — includes rollback steps and regional pin examples.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z, rollout_id=r-2026-03-20-01, canary=5%.

ajay: 23:30 update: canary stable. p50 +3%, errors 0.2%, eviction delta 4%. Moving to 30% in 10m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Stepped to 30% at 2026-03-20T23:42:00Z.

ajay: 00:15 update: 30% stable, eviction delta 6%, stepping to 70%.

oncall-sre: 00:50 alarm: small spike in kv evictions in EU edge nodes, investigating. Holding rollout. :warning:

lina: Hold acknowledged. Ajay revert the step to 30% and open rollback if it persists.

ajay: Reverting step, reapplying US pin, draining EU nodes from new kernel. `deploy-bot rollback-step r-2026-03-20-01 --to-step=2`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Step reverted to 30% at 2026-03-21T00:55:00Z. Rolling back EU nodes from kernel-3.14.2 -> 3.13.9.

maria: Notes updated: paused EU due to eviction instability; docs PR updated with notice.

lina: Thanks team. We'll reconvene tomorrow 14:00 UTC to review telemetry and decide full rollout vs full rollback. :thumbsup:
